faults.criterion: each rebound carries on for only part of the way the throw still had left (deciders T_KERNEL and sc_storeroom_mortar_rebound_legs V_SHORTER)
evidence: lane2/planted_results.jsonl C_FLYER_REBOUND_FROM_WHOLE_THROW: RM_ThingFlyer_Knockback.StartLeg cellsLeft = res.cellsPlanned (the whole throw); every offline suite stayed green, the situation map included

V_SHORTER compares each rebound leg with the journal's item_rebound `left`, the very value the flyer computes, so under that fault a rebound longer than the true cells left (planned 6, first leg 4: left 2, rebound floor(0.7 x 6) = 4) reads 4 of 6 and passes
the real build is right: StartLeg sets cellsLeft = cellsPlanned - cellsTravelled, and that one value feeds both KbPlanner.Rebound and the journal; the scene is UNRUN until Stage 6
faults.smallest_fix: V_SHORTER also derives the cells left from the leg's own budget (item_move planned, or the rebound's cells) less the leg flown from positions, and refuses a `left` that disagrees
